Description: Settings for the kmeans pre-clustering stage at the ``{simpl}`` wildcard. Naming trap: this config block feeds the rule named ``cluster_simpl`` — the historical rule name ``simplify_network`` no longer exists.
When building multiple networks, use 'population' if you want to ensure the clusters are assigned constant names.
Clustering algorithm for the pre-clustering stage (HAC has been removed).
Settings for the final clustering stage at the ``{clusters}`` wildcard.
When building multiple networks, use 'population' if you want to ensure the clusters are assigned constant names.
Clustering algorithm for the final clustering stage (HAC has been removed).
Carriers whose generators are dropped from the network before clustering.
If true, bin generators of a carrier into low/medium/high efficiency classes before aggregation so that efficiency spread survives clustering.
Specify the method of aggregating generator attributes (e.g. ``build_year``, ``ramp_limit_up``, ``heat_rate``) when generators are combined during clustering.
Temporal aggregation — the primary temporal-resolution knob for solved networks. Equivalent to (and written by) the ``nH`` / ``nSEG`` tokens of the ``{opts}`` wildcard.
Resample electricity-only networks to every n hours; ``false`` keeps native hourly resolution.
Resample sector-coupled networks to every n hours; ``false`` keeps native hourly resolution.

Optional per-region share of clusters in the form ``California: 0.5``, placing half of all clusters in that region. Fractions must sum to at most 1. Applied by the kmeans algorithm in both ``cluster_simpl`` and ``cluster_network``; ``null`` distributes clusters by the configured weighting.
